expected_graph.description: Repositories hidden under dot-directories, ignored by a host repo's .gitignore/.ignore, nested inside other working trees (plus one twice-nested case), placed under cache/tmp/build/node_modules directories, and nested under a host's conventional .git/objects/<fanout>/ paths. The three host repositories (ignored_host, nested_host, admin_host) and the twice-nested innermost repo are additional to the category counts.
invariants: finding a repository never silently prunes its working tree
repositories under .git/objects paths are not confused with object-store internals

notes: scale = final target, still pending baseline-pilot calibration; scale_pilot = M5-Max pilot measurable in seconds; scale_smoke = CI smoke. repos must equal the sum of the five category counts.
title: Ignored/hidden nested repositories
